candidate.feature_policy: Unchanged frozen N4 modality/span feature branches; no new modal/quote features in this head-only pilot.
candidate.initialization: Copy the same exact completed N4 split34 and full6x64 start/end matrices plus six biases into four independent actor tensors; fresh Adam owns only those four tensors. Do not resume trained N8 CE weights or moments. Only actor row0 enters returned actor scores; full6 projection preserves parent arithmetic geometry. Require632-source binary32 parity before any update.

comparison.common_initialization: Same exact authenticated N4 split checkpoint, not the trained N8 CE child.
comparison.reference: Frozen completed N8 actor-boundary CE output evidence

derivation.new_closed_policy: Only actor-ranking-hinge objective accepted; rankingON coefficient0.25/margin1 existing filtered domain.
derivation.outer_trace_binding: Reject internally valid targeted diagnostics when hinge_applied is OFF; retain full completed batch/objective/freeze traces.
derivation.strategy: Versioned standalone N8-derived outer; no monkeypatching or modification of measured owners.

detached_controls.limits: AST and stdlib scalar/vector fakes qualify source contracts only; no numerical kernel or accuracy claim.

evaluation.complete_initial_gate: All632 sources: raw modality/presence/start/end binary32 parity and unchanged source/readout observations before any update.
evaluation.protected_final_gate: All632 sources: original34 and inactive copied actor rows unchanged; modality/presence/nonactor raw heads exactly preserved. Actor logits may change joint selection, overlap resolution or abstention.

interpretation_limits: Full IR is exact equality of modality plus actor/action/object/conditions/exceptions/temporal; actor-role improvement alone is not complete-IR improvement.
Frozen modality decisions cannot repair selected wrong-modality outputs through actor logits alone.
Actor logits can alter joint overlap resolution and abstention, including selected nonactor spans despite bit-exact nonactor logits.
All464 diagnostics, including N7 fresh72, are exposed engineering diagnostics and support no new blind generalization claim.
This design records a bounded pilot; technical source/resource gates do not create a new user permission requirement.

Ranking may change actor selection and joint nonactor coupling; higher training accuracy is a question to measure after durable freeze, not a preregistered conclusion. No lambda1 or wider-domain experiment is included.

training.inactive_gradients_and_moments: Exact zero rows1 through5 before and after every completed update; original34 gradients None and values unchanged.
training.objective: Unchanged targeted main CE plus0.25*mean_actor_hinge; only actor start/end row0 has connected gradients. Frozen-role, presence and modality terms remain constant in the reported scalar. Reuse the existing margin1 compatible-span hinge, domain, detached argmax, differentiable wrong/gold scores and closed diagnostics without modification.

ranking.argmax: Detached vectorized complete-domain scores; exact ties use earliest row-major coordinates; selected wrong and gold scores are recomputed or retained with gradients.
ranking.empty_domain: Differentiable zero on valid actor logits; all rows remain in the batch mean.
ranking.inference: Existing topK-before-compatibility readout unchanged; no new candidate-coverage guarantee.
ranking.negative_domain: Complete row-major source-token spans left<=right, excluding exact gold actor and every span overlapping present GOLD nonactor facets; training labels only.
